metadata.description: HerbertGao's self-hosted AI coding skills marketplace.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Portable adversarial review loop for Claude Code: Code Reviewer + Reality Checker are always required; the initial round may add zero or multiple highly relevant Agency Agents domain experts, with no seat cap. It merges findings, applies the smallest accepted fixes, checks and re-reviews them, and gives a repeated blocker one fresh root-cause escalation before NOT-CONVERGED. Missing catalog or structural isolation never blocks the loop; Claude may optionally add a review-only Codex rescue pass. Architecture selection belongs to council.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Multi-perspective council for one open decision, including architecture selection when a draft already exists and the goal is to choose rather than edit. Incumbent-draft mode adopts a neutral brief, runs blind challenger search, then reveals and compares the draft. Canonical records may reach CONVERGED; weaker hosts return unaudited, non-authorizing ADVISORY. Use review-loop to find and fix artifact defects to APPROVE. Requires ~/.agency-agents.

plugins.name: opsx
plugins.description: Orchestrated OpenSpec apply — the main agent groups pending tasks by scope and dispatches a worker per group (parallel then serial by dependency), only managing OpenSpec state and reviews; it never writes implementation code itself. Ships /opsx:apply-subagent (Claude subagent worker) with its SOT skill. Requires the agency-agents catalog at ~/.agency-agents (install per the README); a role it cannot resolve there halts the run rather than standing in a fabricated expert.
